graph_diagnosis.summary: Inflation, consumer confidence, technology-correction sentiment, and financial-market activity provide limited reusable Nasdaq context.
weaknesses: All direct links to the resolved option are excluded.
The graph lacks supported tech earnings, valuation, breadth, and policy-rate mechanisms; bridge support is weak and needs current verification.

search_factors.why_search: Inflation affects expected discount rates and growth valuations.
Consumer confidence can indicate growth and risk-appetite conditions.
Technology correction risk can affect growth-equity sentiment.
M&A activity can indicate financial-market conditions but is indirect for Nasdaq.

checkpoints.mechanism: Lower inflation can reduce expected discount-rate pressure.
checkpoints.evidence_requirement: Inflation cooling and rate futures agree.

checkpoints.mechanism: Consumer-price data can confirm or challenge a disinflation narrative.
checkpoints.evidence_requirement: Headline and core measures support the same rate view.

checkpoints.mechanism: Souring confidence can weaken growth and risk appetite.
checkpoints.evidence_requirement: Confidence, spending, and market breadth weaken together.

checkpoints.mechanism: Technology correction risk can raise volatility and pressure growth-equity valuations.
checkpoints.evidence_requirement: Volatility, positioning, and earnings revisions worsen together.

checkpoints.factor: Discount rates and technology risk appetite
checkpoints.mechanism: Inflation, expected rates, consumer confidence, tech earnings, valuation, breadth, and risk sentiment combine to determine Nasdaq direction.
checkpoints.evidence_requirement: Verify current inflation, rate futures, tech earnings, valuations, breadth, confidence, and volatility.
checkpoints.contradiction_signal: Nasdaq moves diverge from current drivers.

causal_paths.generalized_mechanism: Disinflation can ease expected discount-rate pressure on growth equities.
Weak confidence and technology risk can pressure growth-equity sentiment.

alternative_hypotheses.discriminating_evidence: Compare rate futures with confidence, breadth, and volatility.

forecast_audit_questions: Do inflation and futures support easier rates?
Are tech earnings and breadth improving?
